versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the open-notion skill.
- Opens Notion in the user's Brave browser, focusing an existing window when possible.
- Reuses existing Notion tabs to avoid duplicates.
- Navigates directly to the user's authenticated Notion workspace/dashboard if already signed in.
- Ensures privacy by never entering or requesting credentials.
- Confirms the destination is a valid Notion page before reporting success.
